name: Prenatal+
headline: Prenatal+
description: A vitamin and mineral complex to support the health of mother and child. It helps support a healthy pregnancy and lower the risk of birth defects; when planning a pregnancy it is recommended for both parents 3-4 months before conception.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule once a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Omega-3 fatty acids, vitamin E, niacinamide, pantothenic acid, vitamin B12, zinc, vitamin B6, selenium, vitamin B1, vitamin B2, folic acid, iodine, vitamin D3, biotin, excipients.
